name: Projects REST API
description: RESTful API for managing projects with mock data - reference implementation demonstrating clean REST design patterns

features.name: Initialize Python Project
features.description: Set up Python project structure with FastAPI, Pydantic, and development dependencies
steps: Create requirements.txt with fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic>=2.5.0
Create requirements-dev.txt with pytest, pytest-cov, httpx, ruff, black
Create src/__init__.py and src/main.py entry point

features.name: Create Project Pydantic Models
features.description: Create Pydantic v2 models for Project entity with validation rules
steps: Create Project model with all 7 fields (id, name, description, status, owner, created_at, updated_at)
Create ProjectCreate request model with validation (name 1-100 chars, description 0-1000 chars)
Create ProjectUpdate request model with required fields
Verify: Model validation rejects invalid data

features.name: Create Response Wrapper Models
features.description: Create standardized response wrapper models following constitution format
steps: Create ResponseMeta model with timestamp field
Create PaginationMeta model with total, limit, offset, timestamp
Create ProjectResponse wrapper for single project
Create ProjectListResponse wrapper for project list
Verify: Response models serialize correctly to JSON

features.name: Implement MockDataStore
features.description: Create in-memory data store with singleton pattern for CRUD operations
steps: Implement get_all(status, limit, offset) with filtering and pagination
Implement get_by_id(id) returning project or None
Implement create(project) with UUID and timestamp generation
Implement update(id, data) with updated_at timestamp

features.name: Create Seed Data Generator
features.description: Generate 52 realistic projects with varied owners and statuses on startup
steps: Define 8-10 owners with distribution (some have 10+ projects)

features.name: Create FastAPI App with CORS
features.description: Create main FastAPI application with CORS middleware and API versioning
steps: Add CORS middleware allowing all origins
Add startup event to seed data
Verify: uvicorn src.main:app runs and /docs loads

features.name: Implement GET /projects List
features.description: List projects endpoint with pagination (limit, offset query params)
steps: Return ProjectListResponse with meta.total, meta.limit, meta.offset

features.name: Implement GET /projects/{id}
features.description: Get single project by UUID with 404 handling
steps: Validate UUID format in path parameter
Verify: GET with valid ID returns project, invalid returns 404

features.name: Implement POST /projects
features.description: Create project endpoint with validation and 201 response
steps: Set created_at and updated_at to current time
Default status to 'active' if not provided
Verify: POST creates project and returns with ID

features.name: Implement PUT /projects/{id}
features.description: Update project endpoint with 404 handling
steps: Verify: PUT updates project and changes updated_at

features.name: Implement DELETE /projects/{id}
features.description: Delete project endpoint with 204 response
steps: Return 204 No Content on success (no body)
Verify: DELETE removes project, subsequent GET returns 404

features.name: Add Status Filter Query Param
features.description: Add ?status=active|archived filter to GET /projects
steps: Add status query parameter to GET /projects
Return all projects when status not provided
Update meta.total to reflect filtered count

features.name: Create Custom Exception Classes
features.description: Create exception classes for API errors (404, 422, 400)
steps: Create base APIException class with code, message, status_code, details
Verify: Exceptions can be raised with proper attributes

features.name: Implement Error Handler Middleware
features.description: Global exception handlers converting errors to standard response format
steps: Verify: Invalid request returns proper error format

features.name: Format Validation Errors (422)
features.description: Ensure validation errors include field-level details
steps: Format Pydantic validation errors with field names
Include multiple errors in single response
Map field names to match request body
Add clear error messages for each field
Verify: Missing name and owner returns both errors

features.name: Handle 404 Not Found Consistently
features.description: Use standard error format for all 404 responses
steps: Include requested ID in error details
Verify: All 404s return consistent format with NOT_FOUND code

features.name: Add Validation Edge Cases
features.description: Handle edge cases: invalid JSON, invalid UUID, boundary values
steps: Handle invalid JSON with 400 Bad Request
Validate UUID format in path params (422 for invalid)
Verify: All edge cases return appropriate errors

features.name: Implement /health Endpoint
features.description: Health check endpoint for monitoring
steps: Register health router in main app

features.name: Configure OpenAPI Metadata
features.description: Complete OpenAPI documentation with tags and descriptions
steps: Add description explaining the API purpose
Add localhost server in servers list
Add operation IDs to all endpoints

features.name: Export OpenAPI Spec to File
features.description: Create script to export OpenAPI specification to YAML

features.name: Verify Swagger UI Functionality
features.description: Ensure Swagger UI works for all endpoints
steps: Verify all endpoints visible with descriptions
Test 'Try it out' for each endpoint
Verify: All endpoints testable in Swagger UI

features.name: Set Up Pytest with Fixtures
features.description: Configure pytest with test client and shared fixtures
steps: Create seeded_client fixture with seed data
Add fixture to reset MockDataStore between tests
Create pytest.ini or configure in pyproject.toml

features.name: Write Model Unit Tests
features.description: Unit tests for Pydantic model validation
steps: Test ProjectCreate rejects missing required fields

features.name: Write Data Store Unit Tests
features.description: Unit tests for MockDataStore CRUD operations
steps: Test create adds project with generated ID
Test get_by_id returns None for missing
Test count with and without filter

features.name: Write CRUD Integration Tests
features.description: Integration tests for all CRUD endpoint happy paths
steps: Test GET /projects returns list with correct format
Test POST /projects creates with 201 and returns project
Test PUT /projects/{id} updates and returns project

features.name: Write Error Handling Tests
features.description: Integration tests for all error scenarios
steps: Test error response format matches spec

features.name: Write Pagination/Filter Tests
features.description: Integration tests for pagination and status filtering
steps: Test custom limit and offset values
Test offset beyond total returns empty list

features.name: Write Edge Case Tests
features.description: Integration tests for specification edge cases
steps: Test empty project list returns {data: [], meta: {...}}
Test name exactly 100 chars is valid
Test description exactly 1000 chars is valid
Test invalid UUID format returns error
Test extra fields in request are ignored

features.name: Verify 90%+ Test Coverage
features.description: Run coverage report and ensure target met
steps: Add tests for uncovered paths if needed

features.name: Create Dockerfile
features.description: Production-ready Dockerfile using Python slim image

features.name: Create docker-compose.yml
features.description: Docker Compose configuration for easy local development
steps: Define api service building from Dockerfile
Add optional volume mount for development
Verify: docker-compose up starts the app

features.name: Create .dockerignore
features.description: Exclude unnecessary files from Docker build context
steps: Verify: Docker build context is minimal

features.name: Test Container Build and Run
features.description: Verify Docker container works correctly
steps: Build image with docker build -t projects-api .
Run container with docker run -p 8000:8000 projects-api
Check container logs show startup info
Verify: Container runs and serves API correctly

features.name: Document Docker Usage in README
features.description: Add Docker build and run instructions to README
steps: Verify: README has complete Docker instructions
